description: co2gap — an open pipeline for measuring the CO2 of European flights against a fuel-optimal ideal, from ADS-B trajectories is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors co2gap. A pipeline that reconstructs flight trajectories from open ADS-B archives and computes, for each flight, the CO2 actually emitted against that of an ideal trajectory: same aircraft type, direct great-circle route, fuel-optimal altitude and speed profile for the distance, and the same real wind from ERA5. Coverage: continental; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is Apache-2.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
